title: Combine phone project connections
responsibility: Lists the phone account projects alongside granted Mac projects while keeping each request with its own authority.

inputs.name: cloud
inputs.description: The phone’s own Google account connection.

inputs.name: mac
inputs.description: The paired Mac connection, limited to its explicit grant.

outputs.name: projects
outputs.description: Deduplicated projects from reachable connections. Hosted IDs stay with the account; local-* IDs stay with the Mac.

outputs.name: operations
outputs.description: Routes requests and run cancellation to the connection that owns them, and releases finished run routing entries.

errors.name: refused
errors.description: A refused operation is reported from its original connection and never retried with another authority.
